claimant: Shelborn Drummond Ltd (application documents, as recorded by APRS)
preferred_rationale: Most precise figure, attributed to the application documents; the rounded 210 MW and 213 MW figures in campaign material and press appear to derive from it. Whether it denotes IT load or grid import is not stated.
notes: APRS case page records the size as 212.42 MW.

claimant: Press reports (Scottish Construction Now, The Register, DCD)
notes: Reported as 'an IT load of up to 213MW' for the two-building campus.

claimant: APRS (Dr Kat Jones): 'the data centre will draw 210MW from the grid'
notes: Campaign characterisation ahead of the committee hearing; APRS equated this to powering a quarter of a million homes. Cockburn Association similarly cited peak electricity demand of 210-213 MW.

Diesel standby generators in enclosed compounds (with flues/'chimneys') were proposed; consultation material promised 'low carbon back-up generation' but no capacity, generator count or fuel figures were located. APRS claimed running the generators at scale would equate to '100,000 idling cars-worth of diesel'; generator noise and emissions impacts on nearby planned housing were raised at committee.
